purpose: proof only: formatter delta, exact 40/4 RED, reviewed fix, 40/0 GREEN, lint; no commit or push
formattingPolicy: Any formatter change outside either pre-reviewed tree stops before that phase tests; capture delta for independent review and a revised payload.
timeoutPolicy: 35-minute proof-script deadline, 40-minute proof step; setup steps individually capped. 120-minute job exceeds sum of step timeouts. Forced cancellation may still omit artifacts; missing evidence never passes.
priorResult: lintFix successful, reviewed formatting-only delta, stopped before tests/patch
deprecationOriginPolicy: Request same deprecation trace flag as canonical Gradle wrapper; post-run exact ledger audit required
